paragraphs.text: Coward is a creature type representing people who lack courage in facing danger, difficulty, opposition, pain, etc.; timid or easily intimidated persons.

The first creature to be printed with this type was Craven Hulk from Kaldheim . Before this, the type was not used in any type line – not even on tokens . Changelings , notably, always counted as Cowards.

The subtype had been only mentioned on three cards before receiving a creature with the type printed on it ( Boldwyr Intimidator ( Future Sight ), and Pyrophobia and Reprobation from Modern Horizons ). Unfinity added Scared Stiff , while Duskmourn: House of Horror added the type to Norin .

Boldwyr Intimidator , Kargan Intimidator , and Gornog, the Red Reaper can change creatures into Cowards and disallow Cowards to block Warriors . Craterous Stomp does the same for both Warriors and Giants .
Pyrophobia disallows Cowards to block in general.
Reprobation can change creatures into Cowards with base power and toughness 0/1.
Coward ( Doctor Who ) is a sorcery that can change creatures into Cowards.
Norin was a notable coward despite not having the type on his original card . He had gained the type on his second card by the time he traveled to Duskmourn .
